title: Identifying Confounded Additive-Noise Mechanisms and Residual Laws from Parent-Shift Interventions
banked_reason: D-1.2 producer boundary exhausted three attempts through invalid schema metadata, a noncanonical output path, and unmatched inline-math delimiters; operator deferred the required redesign and directed terminal banking.
gap_reasons: For a failed parent-cell certificate p_star may belong to the observational support by definition of H_i, but W4 requires every observational row to avoid p_star; its point modification therefore cannot simultaneously preserve P_obs in that allowed case.

f^D is declared unique even when C_Delta=0, but the mean-zero normalization does not eliminate a nonconstant zero-mean kernel element; define it only conditional on C_Delta=1 or as a set-valued inverse.
The shrinking neighborhood, stability modulus, implementation-error metric, sampling experiment, and minimax loss are unspecified, so neither 'largest' nor the proposed lower bound is defined.
The angle-1 revision could not pass the D-1.2 producer boundary after three attempts: invalid schema metadata, persistence to a noncanonical path, then unmatched inline-math delimiters.
proof_attempt_summary: Angle 0 pursued an exact direct-intervention-cover iff, but an observed atomic parent cell refuted necessity: observational means can identify the missing mechanism value without direct coverage. Angle 1 pivoted to a functional operator-rank frontier and received a repairable field-tier REVISE, but three D-1.2 author attempts failed the producer boundary before a corrected proposal could be reviewed. The operator deferred the required boundary redesign, so the run was banked as a retry rather than as a mathematical defeat.
tldr: Known soft interventions that translate a node's natural parent vector reveal differences of its structural function while exactly cancelling an arbitrary parent-dependent disturbance regression. The proposal proves that all mechanisms, the complete joint residual law, every hard-intervention distribution, and every bounded analysis of interest are identified if and only if the induced translation-difference operator has only constants in its kernel. Failure of this rank cover yields two bounded non-Gaussian SCMs, built with a four-point Rademacher residual, that agree on the entire observational-plus-shift tuple but disagree under a hard intervention.
gap: Published confounded additive-noise cover results use surgical parent interventions and Gaussian disturbances, while graphical soft-intervention results do not exploit additive structure to recover mechanisms or a dependent residual law.
fill: The shift-difference null space supplies an exact necessary-and-sufficient design criterion, an explicit residual-pushforward functional, and a matching bounded non-Gaussian indistinguishability construction.
